_comment: Hardware session 1 data-collection plan used by tools/hw/collect_all.py. Each session is a separate recording session: the box is re-placed and the setting changed before it starts, so train (S01-S03) and held-out test (S04) data never share a setup. 2 trials x 25 s per class -> about 22 windows per class per session (minimum needed: 30 train / 10 test per class). Operator ids are anonymous. Round 2 (2026-11-18): S04 re-designated validation (see data/splits.json); S05 = NORMAL-only training session (4 varied gentle trials); S06 = new independent test session, recorded only after the model is frozen. Run with --ui terminal (typed confirmations).

sessions.setup: Board flat in the box, sensor facing the lid. Box on the desk.
Turn the whole box 90 degrees and move it to another spot on the desk.
Move the box to a different surface (chair, shelf or floor mat).
VALIDATION session (was held-out in round 1): re-seat the board in the box and use a new spot not used before.
NORMAL-only training session. Box closed, board inside, USB cable slack. Start from a spot not used before.
NEW TEST session: re-seat the board in the box, close the lid, use a spot and surface not used before.

setup_correction_20261118: All S01-S06 sessions were actually recorded with the bare RT-Spark board held directly by hand, with no box or enclosure; the setup texts below describe the plan. See data/metadata_correction_20261118.json.
